title: Seller account settings
description: Per-seller settings read by tools/ebay_api.py and tools/validate_payload.py. Written by `python tools/ebay_api.py setup`; gitignored because the IDs identify the seller.

marketplace.description: eBay marketplace ID, e.g. EBAY_US (the only one tested)

merchantLocationKey.description: Inventory location every offer ships from

return.description: Default return policy ID (30-day, buyer pays)

return_14_day.description: 14-day return policy; only a few categories accept it

disallowed_fulfillment.description: Fulfillment policies the validator refuses (e.g. calculated shipping that causes package errors)

pipeline.description: Thresholds; missing keys take the defaults in tools/account_config.py

price_review_threshold.description: USD; offers above this need human review

fvf_rate.description: Final value fee rate used for net-proceeds estimates
